title: Umona Owawudla
intro: Indaba endala kunanoma yimuphi umbuso noma umbhalo—inhlekelele yokuqala yomuntu eyazalwa umona. Umphefumulo owodwa, omdala wezingane ezimbili ezazalwa abazali bokuqala, wabuka ngentukuthelo njengoba umfowabo omncane ethola umusa owenqatshwa. Okwalandela kwaba ukukhetha okubi kakhulu, kwashiya igazi lokuqala elachitheka emhlabeni. Ungakwazi yini ukuthola ukuthi ungubani, isilingo, kanye nokuzisola okubuhlungu?
clues: Ngazalwa ngabantu ababili bokuqala ukuhamba emhlabeni.
Ngake ngenza umnikelo ku-Allah, kodwa awuzange wamukelwe kimi.
Umnikelo womfowethu wamukelwa, kanti owami wenqatshwa—into engangingenakuyithwala.
Ngaba ngowokuqala ukubulala emhlabeni, ngabulala umfowethu.
U-Allah wathumela isidalwa somhlaba—inyoni emnyama eyayimba emhlabathini—ukuze angifundise ukufihla engangikwenzile, futhi ngasala ngizisola kuphela.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
